early_stopping.metric: validation query MRR (same tie rule as evaluation)

validation_split: query-level 80/20 stratified by training window, rng [20261026, 8000 + s, k, L]
z_G: logit of global HGB(T); window k via 5-fold OOF, earlier windows via full model
placebo: within-window query-level permutation of D rows (repeat/truncate)
D_RDH_zero_rule: D_RDH = 0 when neither sender is in an F3 component of size >= 2
purpose: supplementary robustness check (not the frozen setting): best development setting of the feature family D_RDH + D_S, L = 8, applied to the 22 confirmation repetitions (H = 1,000, seed 1); user request 2026-11-24
